candidates.name: TRELLIS 1 mesh-only multiview
candidates.main_code_and_model_terms: MIT; official model card and repository statement cover weights. Model repository has no separate LICENSE file.
candidates.multiview: Official run_multi_image conditions one generation on multiple image embeddings. It is a tuning-free adaptation of a single-image model, not a separately trained calibrated multiview reconstructor; quality is explicitly uncertain.
candidates.selected_output: Mesh decoder has use_color=true; export its native vertex colours to PLY/GLB and inspect in Blender. Avoid stock to_glb(), which bakes from Gaussian/radiance-field renders.

flexicubes.terms: Apache-2.0 in pinned LICENSE.txt and both source headers; supports voxelgrid_colors. Older non-commercial conclusions do not describe this pinned revision.

image_conditioner.name: dinov2_vitl14_reg
image_conditioner.terms: DINOv2 base code/weights Apache-2.0. Separate Cell-DINO code/weights are non-commercial and excluded.
image_conditioner.required_loader_change: Do not call unmodified torch.hub.load on current hubconf.py: it eagerly imports Cell-DINO. Import only the reviewed DINOv2 backbone path and pin/hash the selected checkpoint before inference.

known_blocks_in_stock_setup: Gaussian general_utils.py and gaussian_render.py have explicit Inria non-commercial headers.
Stock representations/__init__.py eagerly imports Gaussian, even when requesting mesh output.
Stock pipeline loader instantiates every decoder in pipeline.json, including Gaussian/radiance-field decoders.
Do not install/import mip-splatting, diff-gaussian-rasterization, diffoctreerast or their restricted helpers.
Do not download background-remover weights: all selected references already have alpha.
required_preflight: Isolate mesh-only imports and four learned TRELLIS components, preserving exact learned weights and failing on missing/unexpected learned state.
Audit all transitively imported source files and installed dependency versions; record licence notices and pin compatible Kaolin/attention/sparse-convolution packages.
Run an import audit with forbidden modules absent, plus a synthetic coloured-mesh export/load check. Source inspection alone is not runtime proof.
Retain MIT/Apache copyright, licence and modification notices with the preparation bundle; review distribution obligations separately for a shipped app.
candidates.download_size_limit_note: 2.664 GB is only the four TRELLIS checkpoints; DINOv2 weights and runtime packages are additional and unmeasured here. No weight bytes were downloaded or locally verified.
candidates.hardware: Official Linux/NVIDIA requirement is at least 16 GB VRAM. Existing Colab L4 class meets nominal capacity, but this modified runtime, peak memory and full-session cost are untested.
known_quality_limits: Native vertex colours may lose fine face, gill and leopard-print detail compared with a baked texture.
The eight generated references are approximate and uncalibrated; supplying more views does not guarantee compatible geometry.
A static clothed mesh is not a rig, a separate base body, removable clothes, facial controls or reusable actions.

A reconstruction-only adaptation is a different route requiring camera/architecture/dependency validation.

proposed_next_steps: Prepare and verify the isolated TRELLIS 1 mesh-only dependency/import path before any new model trial. Stop if a restricted or unclear component remains required.

If preflight passes and the revised trial is authorized, run one fixed-seed candidate using existing front/back/both-profile PNGs. Use the other four views as review references. Proposed maximum: 60 connected minutes or 30 displayed compute units, whichever comes first; these are ceilings, not expected costs.

Save raw coloured mesh and actual eight-angle Blender renders. Review face, all gill roots, headphones, neck, rear coat, limbs and tail; no manual geometry repair, no unbounded seed search. Stop at the static gate if it fails.

Only after likeness passes, qualify separate automatic rig/body/garment preparation and short breathing/head-turn/walk/cup/deep-breath tests, including a real second garment and train/cafe reuse. These are still unproven.

Integrate the qualified preparer into video-story through P02-P04: choose scene/outfit/routine, prepare complete-character frames in Blender, reuse cache, then continuous scenery/music/preview/export through existing Python services.
app_integration_status: P02-P04 remain blocked on complete P01 proof. No app can yet be claimed to satisfy all requested automation, likeness, outfits and scene/action requirements.
fallback_if_proof_fails: An authored master/rig would require a setup tradeoff; neither a paid tool nor specialist manual setup is authorized by this source-review request. Do not silently relax the automation requirement.
verification_scope: Local snapshot byte counts/SHA-256, published model metadata arithmetic, source-path/import inspection, and existing reference-sheet visual review. No new inference, Blender render, runtime dependency closure or app test was executed.
